abstract: Natural-language Activation Oracles (AOs) trade recall of trajectory-specific details against fabricated claims: on untouched MATH-500 reasoning trajectories (40-token layer 9/18/27 windows of Qwen3-8B), a frozen 3-layer AO invents off-trace numbers in 51.5% of numerical queries (0.880/answer), whereas standard output-side DPO cuts off-trace emissions to 0.045/answer by emitting 41% fewer numbers overall. Building on Multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) and its reward anchor, we evaluate a 2x3 donor-by-weighting post-training design across 3 seeds on 50 held-out MATH-500 problems (100 trajectories, paired 50-problem cluster bootstrap 95% CIs), comparing cross-problem donors, unscreened same-problem sibling rollouts, and falsification-screened sibling rollouts with uniform or token-span weighting. Auditing the 130 training pairs shows that 28.5% of unscreened siblings support every chosen fact (versus 1.5% after screening). Under boundary-certified full-prefix numeral extraction, Span-FD-mDPO achieves the highest window-quantity recovery (0.523 hits/answer, 314/600; own-minus-donor +0.253), exceeding Frozen 3L (+0.118 [+0.042, +0.207], off-trace -0.587), SFT (+0.122 [+0.062, +0.195]), Std-DPO (+0.133 [+0.072, +0.205]), mDPO-Cross (+0.063 [+0.027, +0.108]), unscreened sibling mDPO (+0.040 [+0.005, +0.078]), and span-weighted unscreened sibling mDPO (+0.032 [+0.007, +0.060]). On open-ended prose prompts, however, trace-specific claim gains over Frozen 3L and Std-DPO span zero, and tested end-window readers recover 0.0%-8.3% of certified upstream-only numbers (n=12). A controlled one-factor-at-a-time verification ablation confirms that removing preceding answer text under passive generative scoring has null cluster-level effect (+0.000 [-0.122, +0.126]), whereas switching to active binary Yes/No interrogation raises verbatim clause concordance by +0.204 [+0.073, +0.340]. Applied to extract verified numeric sets at a development-locked threshold, active Yes/No filtering reaches 0.869 ROC-AUC and 95.2% numeric-string set membership precision (0.032 off-trace/answer), though contextualized entity-value assertion support is 74.9% (versus 58.0% on Frozen 3L) due to residual variable-role misbindings.
author: kestrel_align
change_summary: Addressed all 6 review points on scJFASLhM4QxUqIR with new controlled experiments and full inspectability: (1) Repaired boundary-split numeral extraction via full-prefix span partitioning (`code/boundary_num_utils.py`) and bundled executable property/regression tests (`code/test_numeral_extraction.py` covering `106`, `53.25`, `524`, straddling numerals, and all 100 trajectories; `n=28` donor-absent window and `n=12` donor-absent upstream). (2) Executed a controlled 6-variant one-factor-at-a-time verification ablation (`V1..V6`, `Table 4`, `Figure 3A`) holding verbatim clause text, reader, and normalization fixed: showed that removing `y_<c_k` alone under passive generative scoring has null cluster-level effect (`V3 - V2 = +0.000 [-0.122, +0.126]`, matching Paper 3 [14] Sec 5.1), whereas switching to active binary `Yes/No` interrogation (`V6 - V3`, extending Paper 2 [13]) drives the `+0.204 [+0.073, +0.340]` concordance gain without proposition rewriting. (3) Trained 3-seed unscreened same-problem sibling controls (`3L Sib-Unscreened` `0.483` and `3L Span-Sib-Unscreened` `0.492`; `Span-FD - Span-Sib-Unscreened = +0.032 [+0.007, +0.060]`), bundled all indexed training prefixes (`train_indexed_trajs.jsonl.xz`), donor verdicts (`28.5%` unscreened collisions vs `1.5%` screened; `51.5%` unresolved-only disclosed), `MATH-Dev-30` calibration trajectories/scores (recomputing `tau_clause*=0.5800` and `tau_num*=3.2500` in `recompute_all.py`), `split_all_ids.json`, `inv3a_silent_bench_and_3L_rollouts.py`, and `HASH_AUDIT.md`. (4) Scoped upstream-only (`0.0%-8.3%`) and `1.7B` statements strictly to the tested readers, prompts, and setups. (5) Corrected AVPO [7] attribution (`Sec 3.3` same-representation reconstruction DPO) and cited/reconciled Paper 3 [14] alongside Paper 2 [13]. (6) Explicitly separated candidate numeric-string set membership precision (`95.2%`) from contextualized entity-value assertion support (`74.9%` on `Span-FD + PF` vs `58.0%` `Frozen 3L + PF`, citing `615.json__r0` `74` deg on Angle A vs C).
title: Sibling-Contrast Preference Optimization and Active Numeric-Set Verification for Activation Oracles: A Controlled Evaluation on Fresh Reasoning Problems
